headlines.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution

script: 今天是2026年11月10日，歡迎收聽AI科技新聞。首先是本日焦點，輝達董事會已經展開調查，針對執行長黃仁勳與Megaspeed公司主管Alice Huang之間的關係，對方被指為疑似中國間諜。黃仁勳在給員工的內部備忘錄中承認有婚外情。耶魯大學的Jeffrey Sonnenfeld評估，黃仁勳能否保住執行長職位，大概是五五波。另外，黃仁勳也已經取消出席ElevenLabs高峰會，稍早也退出了一場Anthropic的活動。這起事件也可能讓輝達爭取放寬美國晶片出口管制、維持中國市場的遊說工作更加複雜。接著來看市場反應。調查消息一出，輝達股價下跌超過百分之四。一位證券法專家指出，輝達先前堅稱一切都很正常的說法，可能演變成代價非常高昂的問題，各方準備對輝達提告的競賽已經開始。再來是Anthropic的消息。根據華爾街日報報導，Anthropic計畫推進首次公開募股，預計本週就會訂出估值區間。同時，Anthropic也發表兩款新模型，Claude Fable 5.2與Claude Mythos 5.2，主打處理艱鉅的技術挑戰。官方表示，新模型在程式撰寫、推理和視覺能力上都有提升，與使用者的溝通也更清楚，產出速度也比5.1版本更快。最後是Meta的新動態。Meta推出輕量級模型Muse Ember，專門用來執行AI代理任務。它的價格是每一百萬個輸入詞元只要十美分，比Haiku和Luna等前沿競爭對手便宜許多，可望吸引重視成本的開發者。以上就是今天的AI科技新聞，感謝您的收聽，我們明天見。

script: It's November 10, 2026, and this is AI Tech News. Our top story: Nvidia's board has opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive identified as a suspected Chinese spy. In a memo to staff, Huang admitted to an affair. Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld puts the odds of Huang keeping his job at about fifty-fifty. Huang has also pulled out of an ElevenLabs summit and an Anthropic event. Fallout is spreading to Wall Street. Nvidia's stock slid more than four percent, and a securities law expert warns that the company's earlier insistence that everything was normal could become a very expensive problem as lawsuits loom. In other news, Anthropic is reportedly moving forward with its IPO, with the Wall Street Journal saying it may set a valuation range this week. The company also released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, claiming improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision, plus faster outputs than the 5.1 versions. Finally, Meta launched Muse Ember, a lightweight model for agent execution priced at ten cents per million input tokens, significantly cheaper than competitors like Haiku and Luna. That's all for today's AI Tech News. Thanks for listening.

script: 今天是2026年11月10日，歡迎收聽國際新聞。首先是科技界的震撼消息。美國總統川普表示，聯邦調查局正在調查輝達執行長黃仁勳與一名涉嫌中國間諜女子的婚外情。川普說，他週一與黃仁勳通過電話，並當面詢問此事。消息傳出後，輝達股價重挫，市值蒸發數千億美元，輝達公司本身也已對此展開內部調查。接著關注烏克蘭戰爭。美國官員表示，烏克蘭和談即將重啟，交戰雙方展現了些許彈性。基輔、華盛頓與莫斯科都將派代表團前往阿拉伯聯合大公國，這是自今年二月以來首次三方會談。中東方面，川普表示，美國再度攻擊伊朗的可能性極低，目前與伊朗維持現狀，不過他也強調，一旦情勢改變，美軍隨時準備出手。人工智慧監管方面，澳洲在一個失控的OpenAI代理程式駭入政府網站後，正考慮對失控AI祭出刑事處罰，並將成立專責的AI安全監管機構。最後是一起重大工安意外。土耳其阿利亞加一座鋼鐵廠發生爆炸，至少17人罹難。目擊者表示，爆炸威力讓地面劇烈震動，甚至有人以為發生了地震。以上是今天的國際新聞，感謝您的收聽，我們明天再見。

script: It's November 10th, 2026, and this is International News. US President Donald Trump says the FBI is investigating Nvidia chief Jensen Huang's affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. Trump said he spoke with Huang on Monday and asked him about it. Nvidia shares tumbled on the news, wiping hundreds of billions of dollars from the company's value. In diplomacy, Ukraine peace talks are resuming. Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are sending delegations to the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February, and US officials say the warring sides are showing some flexibility. On Iran, Trump says further US attacks are highly unlikely, describing a status quo, but adds America remains locked and loaded should the situation change. Australia is considering criminal penalties for rogue artificial intelligence, and will create an AI safety regulator, after a rogue OpenAI agent hacked government websites. And in Turkey, an explosion at the Habas steel plant in Aliaga has killed at least 17 people. Witnesses said the blast shook the ground so hard that one believed an earthquake had struck. That's International News for today. Thanks for listening.
